author: Siseko Gwegwe
title: Which SABC channel will show Orlando Pirates vs Kaizer Chiefs?
text:
Orlando Pirates and Kaizer Chiefs lock horns in the first Soweto Derby of the 2026/27 season on Saturday 31 October . Kick-off is set for 15:30 at the FNB Stadium .
The South African Broadcasting Corporation (SABC) has confirmed the match will be live on SABC 1 .
ORLANDO PIRATES FAVOURITES TO BEAT KAIZER CHIEFS
It might make for uncomfortable reading for Amakhosi fans but form suggests the Buccaneers are the favourites to win the game. But Pirates coach Abdeslam Ouaddou was also quick to highlight that being favourites does not win you will win the game .
Pirates have seven wins and one draw in eight games in the Betway Premiership this season. The unbeaten run includes a remarkable 18 goals scored and just one conceded.
Meanwhile, across the divide, coach Fernando Da Cruz’s side are also unbeaten in their first eight matches of the term. However, three wins and five draws is a vastly different return. Additionally, Amakhosi have scored 13 goals while conceding eight.
PREDICTED STARTING LINE-UPS
Orlando Pirates: Sipho Chaine, Bulelani Sigomoshe, Lebone Seema, Sbangani Zulu, Deon Hotto, Simphiwe Selepe, Thalente Mbatha, Thapelo Mokobodi, Simphiwe Masilela, Tshepang Moremi, Evidence Makgopa.
Kaizer Chiefs: Brandon Petersen, Reeve Frosler, Thabo Moloisane, Rushwin Dortley, Bradley Cross, Sibongiseni Mthethwa, Lebohang Maboe, Mduduzi Shabalala, Mfundo Vilakazi, Pule Mmodi, Wandile Duba.
LAST 10 RESULTS IN THE SOWETO DERBY
26 April 2026 : Kaizer Chiefs 1-1 Orlando Pirates (Betway Premiership)
28 February 2026 : Orlando Pirates 3-0 Kaizer Chiefs (Betway Premiership)
10 May 2025 : Kaizer Chiefs 2-1 Orlando Pirates (Nedbank Cup Final)
3 May 2025 : Orlando Pirates 2-1 Kaizer Chiefs (Betway Premiership)
1 February 2025 : Kaizer Chiefs 0-1 Orlando Pirates (Betway Premiership)
9 March 2024 : Orlando Pirates 3-2 Kaizer Chiefs (Betway Premiership)
11 November 2023 : Kaizer Chiefs 0-1 Orlando Pirates (Betway Premiership)
6 May 2023 : Kaizer Chiefs 1-2 Orlando Pirates (Nedbank Cup Semi-Final, after extra time)
25 February 2023 : Kaizer Chiefs 1-0 Orlando Pirates (Betway Premiership)
29 October 2022 : Orlando Pirates 0-1 Kaizer Chiefs (Betway Premiership).

summary: The SABC channel for Saturday’s Soweto Derby between Orlando Pirates and Kaizer Chiefs has been confirmed. Sections of Amakhosi fans may hate to hear this but form suggestions the Buccaneers are the favourites to win the game.
